effect_description_eng:
[When Digivolving] By placing 1 blue level 5 or lower Digimon card from your hand under this Digimon as its bottom digivolution card, trash the bottom 2 digivolution cards of 2 of your opponent's Digimon.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When a digivolution card of an opponent's Digimon is trashed, gain 1 memory.
